data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-y', which means 'to please' or 'to delight'. Namiyah is a name that symbolizes joy and happiness, often given to a baby girl in Muslim communities as a sign of hope and blessings. The name Namiyah carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Namiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
